bio: Take the door on the left to a chic, cosmopolitan restaurant specialising in delicious fish and seafood. Or choose the door on the right for the more relaxed brasserie, where an extensive menu of boldly flavoured dishes – featuring plenty of fish – delivers on quality. The range includes classic cuisine and Mediterranean- or Asian-inspired creations. A pristine cod fillet with mashed potatoes and a beurre blanc, a generous bento box featuring sashimi and sushi, or vegetarian tortellini? The choice is yours!...
